name: Sinosteel Engineering & Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Sinosteel Engineering & Technology Co., Ltd. provides industrial engineering and technical services in China and internationally. The company offers engineering solutions for mining and metal processing, such as stockyard, pelletizing, and sintering; low-carbon metallurgy solutions, including coke making, blast furnace, direct reduction, steelmaking, continuous casting, hot rolling, cold rolling, and industrial furnace; and integrated services comprising consulting and planning, and equipment and spare parts.
